reviewer_profile: Theory-leaning reviewer focused on whether the method objects are crisp, falsifiable, and distinct from adjacent prior work.
summary: Proposes decentralized accept-or-forward routing on fixed topologies with terminal-outcome competence calibration (TCPB). Framing around delegation miscalibration is compelling, but core algorithm is a hand-tuned heuristic with only terminal-node credit assignment. Safety gates partially pre-solve routing, weakening self-organization claims.
